scope: 4 independently authored essay targets,4 repair pairs,29 evidence cards,9 source snapshots; factual and functional seed review only

records.findings: All required aspects function in the argument: personal freedom, wealth-limited participation and the limits of compromise. Traditional chronology and late-source uncertainty are explicit. No assertion that Solon created mature democracy, abolished all slavery, or created the property classes from nothing.
records.source_support: Aristotle parts2,5-9,12-14; wiki-solon Archonship, Classes, Seisachtheia, lead uncertainty.

records.findings: Diplomacy is related to defenses, regional legal consolidation and educational capacity. Accession, adversaries/alliance, fortifications, statutory regions,1364 foundation and Ruthenian/Black Sea direction are supported. No unsupported precise statute date or claim of immediate full university operation. Argument is valid but diplomatic examples remain broad.
records.source_support: wiki-casimir Reign/Reforms/Politics_and_expansion; UJ Historia Uniwersytetu, Czasy dawne.

records.findings: Dynastic and military pressures, magnate opposition, incorporation pressure, common institutions and retained autonomy support a coherent qualified judgment.1July agreement is not confused with4July royal signature. No single date is imposed on all incorporations. Noble participation is not universal suffrage.
records.source_support: wiki-lublin Background, Sejm_of_1569, Political, Military; AGAD opening description of1July1569 act.

records.findings: Reform program, state compensation, uneven enforcement, non-universal but real village support, Traugutt organization and2March1864 response are supported. No categorical claim of peasant passivity or zero implementation. Institutional sources differ in emphasis, and the cautious synthesis survives that difference. No claim that the last resistance ended exactly in1864.

method: Read all four complete targets and repair inputs, checked29cards and underlying pinned evidence, with institutional corroboration for all four topic families. Independently verified counts,target identity,prompt hashes,cards duplication,source hashes and HTML revision identifiers. Did not run mutating build/validator scripts.
limitations: Four original targets, not eight independent essays; repair targets are deliberately duplicated.
Repair inputs are synthetic known corruptions; no evidence of robustness to novel errors or factual correction.
Essays are coherent modest exemplars, not exhaustive or official full-mark answers.
Wikipedia remains secondary and imperfect. Institutional corroboration narrows but does not eliminate historical uncertainty.
Source article rights and third-party embedded media differ; do not blanket-license website snapshots.
Review targets response hashes plus prompt/input hashes. Source/metadata additions alone do not invalidate unchanged content acceptance.
